newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Nil trades in SFE wheat as market trends down.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Nil trades in SFE wheat as market trends down.

text.p: Australian wheat futures did not trade on Thursday as financial markets dominated attention.

Wheat settlement prices, the mid-range between bid and ask quotes, were mostly down, especially in distant contracts. November 1996 rose by A$4.50 but November 1997 fell by A$5.00 and both January and March 1998 fell by A$4.00 a tonne.
National wages figures released on Thursday morning took all the interest, Kerrin Gleeson of Elders Risk Management Pty Ltd said. Chicago also failed to provide direction overnight.
Australian Wheat Board indicative cash prices for wheat fell by A$2.00 a tonne across all grades.
